# Data Source: stripe_product_catalog_trial_offer

A trial period a price offers before it transitions to another price.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_product_catalog_trial_offer" "first_month" {
  id = stripe_product_catalog_trial_offer.first_month.id
}
```

## Argument Reference

This data source supports the following arguments:

* `id` - (Required) The ID of the product catalog trial offer to read.

## Attribute Reference

This data source exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `active` - Whether the trial offer can be used for new subscriptions. Defaults to true.
* `duration` - Duration of one service period of the trial. See [`duration`](#duration) below.
* `end_behavior` - Define behavior that occurs at the end of the trial. See [`end_behavior`](#end_behavior) below.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
* `nickname` - A brief description of the trial offer, hidden from customers.
* `price` - Price configuration during the trial period (amount, billing scheme, etc).

<a id="duration"></a>
### `duration`

The `duration` attribute supports:

* `relative` - See [`duration.relative`](#duration.relative) below.
* `type` - The type of trial offer duration. Possible values: `relative`.

<a id="duration.relative"></a>
### `duration.relative`

The `duration.relative` attribute supports:

* `iterations` - The number of iterations of the price's interval for this trial offer.

<a id="end_behavior"></a>
### `end_behavior`

The `end_behavior` attribute supports:

* `transition` - See [`end_behavior.transition`](#end_behavior.transition) below.
* `type` - The type of behavior when the trial offer ends. Possible values: `transition`.

<a id="end_behavior.transition"></a>
### `end_behavior.transition`

The `end_behavior.transition` attribute supports:

* `price` - The new price to use at the end of the trial offer period.
